title: How to build a jewellery wardrobe that lasts.
excerpt: A short guide to choosing pieces that earn their place, season after season, rather than pieces that simply follow a trend.
body: A considered jewellery wardrobe begins with pieces that feel personal and continue to work over time.

title: Why gold keeps coming back.
excerpt: On the enduring appeal of gold, and why it remains a constant across generations of Indian jewellery.
body: Gold carries memory easily. Its warmth and permanence allow it to move naturally between generations.

title: Old-world character, reimagined.
excerpt: A closer look at polki — its history, its character, and how it sits within a contemporary wardrobe.
body: Polki keeps the irregular beauty of an uncut diamond while finding a place in modern dressing.

title: Layering jewellery without losing restraint.
excerpt: A note on building a look with several pieces at once, while keeping the overall effect considered.
body: Layering works best when each piece has room to be noticed and the whole remains balanced.

title: Reading a diamond beyond the sparkle.
excerpt: What proportion, setting and clarity actually mean when you are looking at a piece in person.
body: Proportion, setting and clarity each shape how a diamond feels when seen in person.

title: Pairing polki with modern silhouettes.
excerpt: On bringing an uncut-diamond piece into a wardrobe that otherwise leans contemporary.
body: The contrast between polki and a clean modern silhouette gives both elements room to speak.
